tab_id="ss-19757-faq-1"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]No, walk-ins are welcome during our regular business hours.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="How is the value of my gold or silver determined?" tab_id="ss-19757-faq-2"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]We base our offer on current market prices for precious metals along with the weight and purity of your item, and provide a free appraisal before any offer is made.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Do you buy jewelry too?" tab_id="ss-19757-faq-3"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]Yes, we buy gold, silver, and platinum jewelry in addition to bullion coins and bars.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Is there an obligation to sell once I get an appraisal?" tab_id="ss-19757-faq-4"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]No, our appraisals are free and come with no obligation to sell.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What should I bring with me?" tab_id="ss-19757-faq-5"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]Just bring the items you’d like appraised. A valid ID is required for the transaction.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What is the difference between bullion coins and numismatic coins?" tab_id="ss-19757-faq-6"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]Bullion coins are valued primarily by their metal content and weight, tracking daily spot prices. Numismatic coins carry additional value based on rarity, condition, and historical significance. We buy both types and will explain which category your coins fall into during your free appraisal.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Do you pay more than pawn shops?" tab_id="ss-19757-faq-7"][vc_column_text woodmart_color_scheme="light"]Yes. Pawn shops typically offer 40–60% of melt value because they focus on lending, not buying. As a dedicated precious metals dealer, we pay up to 95% of the current spot price because we sell directly to refineries and wholesalers, cutting out the middleman.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][vc_raw_html css=""][/vc_raw_html][/vc_column][/vc_row]

yoast_metadesc: Get a free, no-obligation appraisal and top cash value for your gold, silver, and jewelry. Visit our Hollywood store, serving Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Silver Lake, and West Hollywood.
